question: Since the Forbidden Library burned down, how does Beatrice mainly spend her days? I imagine things like coordinating with Ryuzu-san and the others must be difficult, but I think it would be really cute if she were managing things such as repairing the books from the Forbidden Library or a newly established Beatrice library.
answer:
I think that would be really cute, so why not go with that? (Laughs)

Beatrice herself really does love reading, so I imagine she simply takes books from Roswaal's room, which has the most books in the mansion, without asking, and then sits on Subaru's bed in his room and reads them.

It's not like she spends all her time with Subaru, either. Sometimes she does things together with Petra. Subaru has become a knight, but he hasn't completely stopped doing his work and various chores as one of the mansion's servants, so Beatrice might join in while they're cleaning the floors with rags or wiping the windows together.

I think she's getting to enjoy the kind of fun, ordinary life that she didn't have back when the Forbidden Library existed.

I wish I could write more of these kinds of everyday-life stories, but everyone would rather Subaru die, so I guess it can't be helped. (Laughs)
